# Beatra Agent Skills

> Installable Agent Skills that plan, direct, and review images, video, music, and voice, then render them on Beatra.

Each Skill runs inside an agent that loads `SKILL.md` (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Cline, OpenClaw, and others) and renders with credits on a Beatra account. Paid steps run only when the person asks for that exact render or approves its confirmation card. The live model catalog (https://docs.beatra.ai/en/docs/models) is authoritative for models, limits, and prices; this file lists none of them.

## Beatra (`beatra`)

Create AI images, videos, music, and voice, look up public social data, edit supported visual results, and keep returned files and credit use easy to track through one shared connection.

Create AI images, videos, music, and voice, look up public social data, edit visual results, and keep generated assets easy to find and manage. Beatra Universal turns text into images, images and references into video, ideas into songs or instrumentals, and scripts into narration, while also supporting custom voice creation and public social media data lookup across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X. Use it as an AI media generator and AI creative suite for text-to-image, image-to-video, AI video editing, AI music generation, text-to-speech, multilingual voice-over, voice cloning, multimodal content creation, and YouTube or TikTok data for posts, comments, accounts, and trends. Reuse source media, returned files, and public social findings across formats, follow production progress, and view actual credit use for completed creative work.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill beatra`
- Installer for any agent: https://beatra.ai/install.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/beatra-ai/ai-media-generator-skill

MCP tools: `beatra.images.generate`, `beatra.images.transform`, `beatra.images.edit`, `beatra.images.understand`, `beatra.videos.generate`, `beatra.videos.enhance_prompt`, `beatra.videos.animate`, `beatra.videos.generate_from_references`, `beatra.videos.interpolate`, `beatra.videos.edit`, `beatra.videos.extend`, `beatra.videos.understand`, `beatra.music.generate`, `beatra.speech.synthesize`, `beatra.voices.clone`, `beatra.voices.list`, `beatra.social.tools.search`, `beatra.social.tools.get`, `beatra.social.execute`

## Talking Avatar & AI Presenter Video (`talking-avatar-video`)

Turn one portrait and a short script or speech track into a directed talking-avatar video for explainers, announcements, lessons, and product messages.

Create a talking avatar from one portrait and a short script or speech track. This AI presenter and digital human video workflow can prepare narration with a selected voice or use a supplied recording, then direct a stable talking-head clip with restrained expression, natural movement, clear delivery, and focused lip-sync review. Use it for AI spokesperson videos, product explainers, training, course lessons, announcements, onboarding, social talking-head content, and photo-to-talking-video messages, with narration-driven facial motion and a focused review of identity, clarity, lip sync, and motion stability.

Use cases:
- Product explainers — Present a short feature, offer, or launch message without a new camera shoot.
- Training and lessons — Deliver a compact onboarding point, course introduction, or internal update.
- Announcements and social — Turn a prepared message into a human-facing announcement or talking-head post.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill talking-avatar-video`
- Installer for any agent: https://beatra.ai/skills/talking-avatar-video/install.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/beatra-ai/talking-avatar-video-skill

MCP tools: `beatra.speech.synthesize`, `beatra.voices.list`, `beatra.videos.animate`

FAQ:

### What do I need to start?

One portrait and either a supplied speech track or a short script plus a voice choice.

### Can I use my own recorded audio?

Yes, when its type and length fit a currently supported video route.

### How are lip sync and presenter consistency reviewed?

The speech drives facial motion, and the finished clip is reviewed for mouth timing, identity, voice clarity, and motion stability before choosing the most useful adjustment.

## AI Logo Maker (`ai-logo-maker`)

Turn a brand name, industry, or reference image into a professional AI logo, brand mark, or app icon with multi-concept exploration, precise brand colors, and scalable composition.

Turn a brand name, industry, or reference image into a professional AI logo, brand mark, or app icon. This AI logo maker and logo generator explores multiple design directions from your brand brief—company name, industry feel, and color preferences—then refines the strongest concept with precise brand colors, clean geometry, and scalable composition. Create business logos, startup logos, monograms, emblems, and combination marks that stay sharp from favicon to storefront sign. Start from a text description, transform existing sketches and brand assets into a polished mark, or refine an accepted draft toward a publish-ready result.

Use cases:
- New business and startup logos — Go from a company name and industry to a professional brand identity, with multiple concepts to compare before choosing a direction.
- App icons and product marks — Create square icons ready for app stores, favicons, software dashboards, and product launches—with safe-area margin built in.
- Brand refresh from existing assets — Transform sketches, mood boards, or an existing logo into a polished modern mark while preserving the original direction.
- Social media and content branding — Build profile avatars, watermarks, and a consistent visual identity that carries across platforms and content formats.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill ai-logo-maker`
- Installer for any agent: https://beatra.ai/skills/ai-logo-maker/install.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/beatra-ai/ai-logo-maker-skill

MCP tools: `beatra.images.generate`, `beatra.images.transform`, `beatra.images.edit`, `beatra.videos.animate`

FAQ:

### What logo styles can I create?

Wordmarks, lettermarks, pictorial marks, abstract marks, monograms, emblems, and combination marks. Share the brand name, industry, and the feeling you want, and the best style for the context is recommended.

### Will my logo work as a tiny favicon?

Every concept is composed for small-size legibility with strong silhouettes, high contrast, and minimal detail. Review the result at thumbnail size before finalizing.

### Can I match my existing brand colors?

Yes. Provide hex color values and the logo generation uses them as the palette foundation, with precise weighted color control.

### Can I refine a logo I already have?

Yes. Upload the existing logo or sketch, describe what to change, and the refinement preserves the overall direction while adjusting specific elements.

## Music Generation Studio (`music-generation-studio`)

Turn a theme, lyric, scene, or reference audio into reviewable songs, instrumentals, BGM, and soundtracks with a clear creative direction and focused revisions.

Create original songs, AI-generated music, lyrics-to-song tracks, instrumentals, background music, video soundtracks, jingles, multilingual songs, and reference-led arrangements from a clear creative brief. This AI music generator and AI song maker develops genre, mood, structure, singable lyrics, vocal direction, and production style, then creates reviewable audio with Suno 6 or another model you explicitly choose. Use it as an AI music studio for songwriting, an AI lyrics writer, text-to-music creation, BGM generation, brand music, podcast themes, game music, bilingual songs, or focused new versions of reference audio. Review vocals, pronunciation, duration, loop points, and arrangement fit after generation, then refine the strongest result.

Use cases:
- Original songs from an idea — Develop a story, mood, lyric fragment, or hook into a structured vocal track with a clear musical identity.
- Lyrics into a song — Use complete lyrics you provide or develop singable words before choosing the genre, voice, and arrangement.
- Video, campaign, and brand music — Create BGM, soundtracks, jingles, and campaign music around pace, emotion, dialogue space, and ending needs.
- Games, podcasts, and product experiences — Build themes, intros, transitions, atmosphere, and instrumental cues from a functional brief.
- Multilingual and reference-led directions — Plan bilingual songs or new arrangements from reference audio, then review melody, vocal character, and arrangement against the intended direction.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill music-generation-studio`
- Installer for any agent: https://beatra.ai/skills/music-generation-studio/install.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/beatra-ai/ai-music-generator-skill

MCP tools: `beatra.music.generate`

FAQ:

### What can Music Generation Studio make?

It can develop and create original songs, instrumentals, BGM, video and game soundtracks, jingles, brand music, podcast themes, multilingual tracks, and reference-led new arrangements.

### Can it write lyrics or use lyrics I already have?

Yes. It can develop singable lyrics from a brief or use complete lyrics you provide, keeping the words aligned with the selected genre, mood, structure, vocal, and arrangement direction.

### How can I shape instrumentals, loopable BGM, and track length?

Set the target duration, ending, loop point, energy curve, dialogue space, and instrumental palette, then listen to the result and refine the timing or edit point for its destination.

### Does it only use Suno?

Suno 6 is the creative default. You can explicitly choose another currently available music model when its capabilities fit the brief.

### Can it use reference audio for a new arrangement?

Yes. Choose what should carry over and what should change, then review the returned melody, vocal character, energy, instrumentation, and arrangement against that direction.

Transform a real product photo into a studio-quality ecommerce image, lifestyle scene, or marketplace-ready hero shot with clean backgrounds, professional lighting, and composition guided by confirmed product details.

Transform a real product photo into a studio-quality ecommerce image, lifestyle scene, or marketplace-ready hero shot. This AI product photography tool replaces backgrounds, improves lighting, and stages scenes while using the source photo and confirmed product details as the visual anchor. Create clean white-background listings, contextual lifestyle compositions, and premium ad visuals from a single phone snap for Amazon, Taobao, Shopify, and social media. Start from one product photo, combine several references, or refine a selected draft toward a polished listing image.

Use cases:
- Marketplace main images — Clean white-background product photos prepared for Amazon, Taobao, Rakuten, and Shopify listing contexts.
- Lifestyle and contextual scenes — Product-in-use images that show the item in a real-world setting, building buyer confidence and desire.
- Ad and campaign visuals — Premium hero shots with dramatic lighting and studio-gradient backgrounds for paid ads and landing pages.
- Social media product posts — Eye-catching product visuals for Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest that stop the scroll and drive clicks.

FAQ:

### How do source details guide the new image?

The source photo and confirmed shape, color, label, proportions, materials, and included pieces become the visual reference for the new background and lighting.

### Can I create clean white-background listing images?

Yes. Share the target marketplace and its current image guidance, then choose a clean white background, even studio lighting, and suitable product framing.

### Can I place my product in a lifestyle scene?

Yes. Describe the desired setting—a kitchen counter, wooden table, bathroom shelf, or seasonal backdrop—and the product is placed in that scene with matching lighting and natural shadow.

### Can I refine a specific area of a selected photo?

Yes. Use the selected image as the base and name the reflection, shadow, edge, color, or small defect that needs a focused adjustment.

## Suno Lyrics to Song (`suno-lyrics-to-song`)

Turn complete lyrics, rough drafts, loose lines, or a hook into a structured Suno song with custom lyrics, clear sections, style, mood, arrangement, and vocal direction.

Turn complete lyrics, a rough lyric draft, loose lines, or an existing hook into a structured, listenable Suno song. This Suno lyrics-to-song workflow works as an AI song generator from lyrics and AI music generator from lyrics: choose Preserve mode to keep every original line or Refine mode to improve rhythm, rhyme, singability, and hook strength. Build the song structure across verses, chorus, bridge, and purposeful repetition, then create a style prompt for music with genre, mood, arrangement, and vocal direction for Suno custom lyrics. Use it to turn lyrics into a song, make a song from lyrics, convert lyrics to music, get help from a lyrics songwriting assistant, or take rough lyrics to song-ready form through a custom lyrics-to-song process.

Use cases:
- Complete lyrics without music — Keep a finished lyric intact while giving it a coherent section order, musical arc, and vocal direction.
- Loose lines and fragments — Sort scattered lyric lines into a singable sequence while preserving their meaning and strongest images.
- An existing hook — Build contrast and supporting sections around a hook that already carries the song's identity.
- A draft that needs better flow — Refine rhythm, phrasing, rhyme, repetition, and section balance while protecting every must-keep line.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill suno-lyrics-to-song`
- Installer for any agent: https://beatra.ai/skills/suno-lyrics-to-song/install.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/beatra-ai/lyrics-to-song-skill

MCP tools: `beatra.music.generate`

FAQ:

### What lyric material can I start with?

You can start with complete lyrics, a rough draft, loose lyric lines, or an existing hook. At least one existing lyric line or hook is needed to begin.

### Can my original lyrics stay exactly as written?

Yes. Preserve mode keeps every lyric-body character, punctuation mark, complete line, and the exact line order unchanged. Only surrounding line breaks or blank-line spacing may be adjusted, and section labels may be added outside the lyric body.

### How are pronunciation, vocal direction, and track length shaped?

Set the language, delivery, vocal character, song structure, and duration direction in the brief, then listen to the finished performance and refine the most important detail in the next version.

### What happens if I change the lyrics after hearing the track?

A lyric or direction change creates a new version and may also change the vocal performance and arrangement, so review the complete updated words and direction before creating it.

## Poster Design Studio (`poster-design-studio`)

Turn a topic description, a product photo, or brand references into a scroll-stopping event poster, promotional banner, or social media graphic with strong visual hierarchy, category-matched styling, and text-safe zones.

Turn a topic description, a product photo, or brand references into a scroll-stopping event poster, promotional banner, or social media graphic. This AI poster maker and design generator creates photo-rich posters with strong visual hierarchy, category-matched styling, and text-safe zones for event, music, movie, product launch, and sale campaigns. Use it as an AI flyer maker for sale flyers, an event poster design tool, a movie poster generator, a music festival poster creator, a banner design AI for product launch posters, or a graphic design poster studio. Start from a campaign topic, transform a product or scene photo with style references, or refine an accepted draft toward a print-ready or share-ready result.

Use cases:
- Event and music posters — Vibrant, energetic event and music festival posters with a bold headline band, a single performer or hero scene, and a structured date and venue block.
- Movie and product launch posters — Cinematic movie posters with dramatic lighting and title-treatment space, plus clean futuristic product launch posters that put the product center stage.
- Sale flyers and promotional banners — Warm, appetizing sale flyers and high-contrast promotional banners with a hero offer zone, product support, and a clear call-to-action.
- Social media graphics — Platform-native 1:1, 9:16, and 16:9 social graphics with one focal subject, a large text-safe zone, and high contrast readiness.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill poster-design-studio`
- Installer for any agent: https://beatra.ai/skills/poster-design-studio/install.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/beatra-ai/ai-poster-maker-skill

MCP tools: `beatra.images.generate`, `beatra.images.transform`, `beatra.images.edit`, `beatra.videos.animate`

FAQ:

### Can I create a poster from just a topic description?

Yes. Describe your event, sale, movie, or campaign and the style direction. The tool generates a complete poster visual from your description with the canvas and text-safe zone you choose.

### Can I turn my product photo into a launch poster?

Yes. Upload your product photo and the tool transforms it into a polished launch poster with a clean background, brand color styling, and a text-safe band for your headline and date.

### Will there be space for my headline and details?

Yes. Every poster reserves a clean text-safe zone—top band, center, or lower third—so you can add your headline, dates, and call-to-action without clashing with the image.

### Can I fix a specific area of an accepted poster?

Yes. Upload the accepted poster, describe what to fix—a cluttered corner, color temperature, or headline contrast—and the edit targets only that area.

## AI Image Generation Studio (`ai-image-generation-studio`)

Generate, compose, and edit product images, brand visuals, posters, social graphics, illustrations, and photo variations.

Create and refine images from a written brief, one to four ordered reference images, or an existing base image. AI Image Generation Studio supports text-to-image generation, reference-guided composition, and focused AI image editing for product photos, ad creative, brand visuals, posters, social graphics, illustrations, concept art, and photo background changes. Review each generated image for message, subject fidelity, composition, style, text, and destination fit, then choose the smallest useful edit, new composition, or new generation.

Use cases:
- Create product images — Place a supplied product into a new scene or generate a new product concept, then check shape, color, label, and destination fit.
- Build ad and brand visuals — Turn one message, palette, and audience into a campaign image or brand-led visual draft.
- Make social graphics and posters — Plan one image around the channel, orientation, room for text, and message.
- Develop illustrations and concepts — Explore a named visual style for an illustration, cover, scene, or concept image.
- Change a photo or background — Use an existing image as the base and focus the requested change on an object, region, background, or overall treatment, then inspect the whole result.

### What can AI Image Generation Studio make?

It can create product images, ad creative, brand visuals, posters, social graphics, illustrations, concept art, photo variations, and background changes from text, references, or an existing base image.

### Can it use my own photos or product images?

Yes. One to four supplied images can guide a new composition, or the first supplied image can remain the base for an edit. Generated details still need review.

### Can it change only part of an image?

Yes. A focused edit targets a defined area of an existing base image, then reviews the whole result for subject, composition, text, and destination fit.

### Which image models does it use?

It matches the image goal, reference materials, canvas, output count, and creative controls with current models, and keeps a named model when it fits those inputs.

### Can it keep a series consistent?

It reuses the selected direction, wording, reference images, subject cues, style, logo placement, and text plan across the series, then reviews each result for visual consistency.

Yes. Use one image as the opening frame, or provide exact first and last images for a directed transition.

## AI Multilingual Dubbing (`ai-multilingual-dubbing`)

Create reviewable multilingual voice-over audio from scripts for each language, with deliberate casting, pronunciation and timing pilots, and delivery organized by market and segment.

Create multilingual voice-over audio from prepared scripts for videos, product launches, e-learning, training libraries, creator content, and international campaigns. This AI multilingual dubbing workflow organizes every market and segment, helps choose a locale-ready voice, pilots pronunciation and timing, and delivers reviewable narration by language. Use it for AI video dubbing audio, AI video translation audio, video localization voice-over, training video localization, global marketing narration, text to speech in multiple languages, or Chinese, English, and Japanese dubbing. Receive narration tracks organized by language, market, and segment, ready for localization editing, lip-sync production, training libraries, and campaign assembly.

Use cases:
- Product and marketing videos — Create localized narration audio for launches, explainers, ads, and cross-border commerce videos from prepared scripts.
- Courses and training libraries — Organize narration by language, lesson, and module, with a representative timing and pronunciation pilot.
- Creator and social videos — Prepare reusable voice-over tracks for channels publishing the same story in several markets.
- Short drama and episodic narration — Produce dialogue or narration as organized audio segments for translation, editing, synchronization, and the wider localization workflow.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill ai-multilingual-dubbing`
- Installer for any agent: https://beatra.ai/skills/ai-multilingual-dubbing/install.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/beatra-ai/multilingual-voiceover-skill

MCP tools: `beatra.speech.synthesize`, `beatra.voices.list`

FAQ:

### Does it translate and dub an uploaded video automatically?

It creates narration audio from scripts prepared for each language and can help shape localized spoken wording. The organized tracks are ready for transcription references, language review, lip sync, and finished-video editing.

### How are voices selected across languages?

Match each market with a voice that supports its language and audience; reuse one voice across markets when its language range and delivery fit the full campaign.

### Can I test before producing the whole release?

Yes. Pilot one meaningful segment per market, review pronunciation, tone, pace, and duration, then carry the selected direction into the remaining narration tracks.

### How do I tune the narration to a video duration?

Use the target duration to guide script length and pace, compare the returned pilot duration, and refine the spoken wording or edit timing for the final cut.

A shot list where the on-screen action and the spoken line are written as separate fields, generated frames for the beats you choose, and a narration track in a voice you select. ### What do you need from me?

The photo and what should go. If several things in the frame match your words, you will be asked which one you mean.

### Will the rest of the photo change?

The canvas follows your original, so framing and aspect ratio stay the same. Marking an area focuses the edit there, and one result always comes back for you to look at before you post.

### Can several things be removed at once?

Yes. Two targets come out together, and a busier frame is cleared in a couple of rounds — each round is its own run, so you see the result before the next one starts.

- GitHub: https://github.com/beatra-ai/beatra-skills/tree/main/skills/bilibili-publishing-pack

MCP tools: `beatra.images.generate`

FAQ:

### Can I start from just a topic?

Yes. A topic and the promise behind it are enough; an outline or script sharpens the description and the tags.

### Can you add chapter timestamps?

Supply the timestamps and they are formatted as chapter markers in ascending order starting at 00:00.

### Can I keep my series title format?

Yes. Name the pattern and it is carried through, so a new episode reads as part of the same series.

### Does it write the copy in Chinese?

Yes, Simplified Chinese by default, since that is what Bilibili audiences read. Ask for another language and it is written in that one.

It can optionally read the field your cover is entering: the titles and public counts of what already ranks for the same topic on YouTube, TikTok, Douyin, and REDnote; on YouTube, a competitor's actual thumbnail image; and your own YouTube channel's recent thumbnails. ## Creator Account Teardown (`creator-account-teardown`)

Read a creator account from a handle, or from the screenshots, bio, captions, and visible post metrics you have, diagnose its positioning, audience, content matrix, hook pattern, and cadence, then turn all of it into your own positioning, pillars, hook formula, opening plan, and a first post produced with its cover rendered and its script voiced.

Take apart a creator account and walk away with your own version of it. Bring what you can see — profile screenshots, the bio, a pasted list of recent posts with their counts, a few captions — or hand it the handle: it reads profiles and recent posts on Douyin, TikTok, Xiaohongshu, Instagram, YouTube and X, and comments on the first three. This account teardown and account diagnosis workflow reads the positioning, the audience it speaks to, the content matrix behind the grid, the hook and structure pattern its best posts repeat, and the posting cadence, then turns it into a build template for your own account: a positioning line, a bio, content pillars with formats and cadence, a viral formula, and an opening plan — finishing with your first post produced, its cover rendered and its script voiced. Use it for competitor account analysis, account benchmarking and comment analysis, for a new account or a stalled one.

Use cases:
- Study the account that owns your niche — Work out what carries a competitor's grid and where the opening for yours is.
- Start a new account with a plan — Turn a benchmark account into your positioning, pillars, cadence, and first ten posts.
- Restart an account that stalled — Put your own grid beside a working one and see which pillar, format, and hook to change first.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill creator-account-teardown`
- Installer for any agent: https://beatra.ai/skills/creator-account-teardown/install.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/beatra-ai/beatra-skills/tree/main/skills/creator-account-teardown

MCP tools: `beatra.images.generate`, `beatra.images.edit`, `beatra.voices.list`, `beatra.speech.synthesize`, `beatra.social.tools.search`, `beatra.social.tools.get`, `beatra.social.execute`

FAQ:

### What do I need to start?

Whatever you can see on the account: profile screenshots, the bio, a pasted list of recent posts with their visible view, like, and comment counts, and a few captions. Plus a sentence about what you are building and who you are.

### Where do the numbers in the diagnosis come from?

From exactly two places: a lookup this Skill ran at your request, or what you supplied. Each row in the evidence table carries its source, and a looked-up figure also carries the time it was read. Anything neither produced is marked as unstated and diagnosed around — never estimated, and never borrowed from what similar accounts usually look like.

### What do I get at the end?

The evidence table, the full diagnosis, the gap read against your own account, a positioning line, a bio, a content matrix with pillar shares and cadence, a reusable hook formula with worked examples, a ten-post opening plan, and the first post produced — its cover image rendered and its script delivered as a voiced track.

Yes. Name the duration and the script is paced to it by adjusting line density rather than cutting the structure.

From you. Prices, results, credentials, and offers are written from the facts you supply, and a missing proof point comes back as a question.

Yes. Mark any brand phrase, product name, or required line as must-keep and it is carried into the script exactly as written.

### Do I get a word-for-word script for the whole session?

The default is four pieces built for use on air: the schedule, a talk track per product, a library of readable lines, and the compliance pass. A full verbatim script for a specific product is written on request — useful for a first-time host, for keeping several hosts consistent, or in a category where wording is screened closely.

### What is rendered rather than written?

A talking-point card for each featured product and a countdown card for each anchor, plus spoken takes of the opening, the urgency lines, and the countdown. Each card carries the product name, the selling points, both prices, and the specification in type that reads from across the room.

FAQ:

### What can I create with MiniMax H3?

Create 2K advertising videos, ecommerce product moments, brand films, dynamic posters, game UI motion, film titles, and social clips with cinematic movement and native stereo sound.

### Can I turn a written idea into video?

Yes. Describe the subject, action, setting, camera feeling, light, and soundscape to turn a written concept into a complete video direction.

### Can I animate a product, character, or artwork image?

Yes. Start from the image and describe how the subject and camera should move while keeping the visual identity at the center of the scene.

### Can I create a video between opening and closing frames?

Yes. Use the two visuals to shape a deliberate beginning, transformation, and ending for product reveals, story beats, and scene changes.

### Can image, video, and audio references guide one creation?

Yes. Give each reference a clear role for subject, style, movement, pacing, or sound and build them into one coherent creative direction.

### How does MiniMax H3 add sound to the video?

MiniMax H3 creates native stereo sound together with the picture. Describe ambience, music, dialogue, or sound-design moments as part of the scene.

### How can I keep a series of MiniMax H3 videos visually consistent?

Reuse the same subject references, visual atmosphere, camera language, color direction, and sound palette across each video so the series feels connected.

### How do I write a strong MiniMax H3 prompt?

Lead with the main subject and action, then add setting, one clear camera move, light, visual mood, and the sound that completes the moment.

### How can I see the current MiniMax H3 price?

Beatra presents the current Credits price for the selected H3 creation so you can shape the video direction with a clear view of cost.

## Publish Preflight Studio (`publish-preflight-studio`)

Paste the copy and get a compliance read with a replacement for every flagged phrase, an audience read that names the line losing each reader, a hook and share score, the corrected copy, and a cover rendered from the fixed wording.

Check a post before it goes out, then fix what it finds. Paste the caption, title, script, on-screen text, or tags — this pre-publish content check reads the wording against advertising-copy restrictions and regulated-category claim rules and returns a replacement for every phrase it flags, reads the post back through the people you are writing for and names the exact line that loses each of them, scores the hook and the reason to share with the evidence behind each score, then hands back the corrected copy and renders the cover carrying the fixed wording. Use it as a social media copy check and a banned words checker before publishing, for ad-copy review, superlative screening, audience reaction testing, hook strength scoring, and pre-checking brand or client copy before it reaches an approver, for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and LinkedIn.

Use cases:
- Pre-checking client or brand copy — Screen wording against advertising-copy restrictions and regulated-category rules before it reaches an approver.
- Testing a post before it ships — Hear how the people you are writing for react while the copy can still change.
- Fixing a cover that has to change — Rebuild the cover around corrected wording while keeping the layout you already approved.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill publish-preflight-studio`
- Installer for any agent: https://beatra.ai/skills/publish-preflight-studio/install.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/beatra-ai/beatra-skills/tree/main/skills/publish-preflight-studio

MCP tools: `beatra.images.generate`, `beatra.images.transform`, `beatra.images.edit`

FAQ:

### What do I need to start?

The copy — a caption, title, script, on-screen text, tags, or all of them together. Platform and category are read from the copy when you do not state them, and what was read is named with the result.

### How are the reader reactions produced?

Reader profiles are built from who the copy is evidently written for, plus any audience detail you supply, and the post is read back through each, with the profile named alongside its reaction so you can see who each reaction stands for.

### Do I have to render a cover?

The three reads and the corrected copy stand on their own as a finished result. The cover is rendered whenever you want the fixed wording carried onto the image.

Use cases:
- A shop account posting daily — Turn each product into a filmable script in one pass, with the link beats already in place.
- Rebuilding a video that already sold — Carry a reference video's segment order and pacing onto your own product, with every claim replaced by your facts.
- A service or local business — Explain what you do in plain speech, then point at the link with a reason the viewer already heard.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill wechat-channels-script-studio`
- Installer for any agent: https://beatra.ai/skills/wechat-channels-script-studio/install.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/beatra-ai/beatra-skills/tree/main/skills/wechat-channels-script-studio

MCP tools: `beatra.images.generate`, `beatra.voices.list`, `beatra.speech.synthesize`

FAQ:

### What do I need to start?

One line about the product or service. Bring the facts you can stand behind, who it is for, and how your account already speaks, and the script gets sharper — but a product line alone is enough to get a full draft.

### Where do the product-link beats go?

On three named segments: the one where the product first appears, the one carrying your strongest supplied fact, and the closing ask. The chain moves with the structure — in an offer-led script the reason arrives early, in an explainer it arrives after the mechanism is clear.

### What if I do not have a price or a test result yet?

The beat is written around it and the gap is listed by name, along with the smallest thing that would close it. Every number in the script traces back to something you supplied.

## YouTube Thumbnail Maker (`youtube-thumbnail-maker`)

Turn a YouTube topic, title, script, key frame, portrait, product photo, or channel reference into three thumbnail directions described in text, then render the one you pick as a 16:9 image with the headline area kept clear. Leave with a title that matches the image and a channel rule the next video can reuse.

Create YouTube thumbnails from a video topic, title, script, key frame, portrait, product photo, or channel reference. This AI thumbnail maker compares three directions in text first, then renders the one you pick as a 16:9 image with clear visual hooks, readable hierarchy, and a headline-safe composition for explainers, reviews, tutorials, vlogs, games, podcasts, and long-form creative videos. It pairs the image with title-matching advice and refines an accepted direction into a consistent channel look. Rendering requires a Beatra account at beatra.ai.

Use cases:
- Explainers and essays — Give a long-form idea a single visual anchor that matches the title's promise instead of restating it.
- Reviews and comparisons — Put the product where the eye lands first and keep the comparison legible at card size.
- Tutorials and how-to — Show the result or the moment of difficulty, with clear space for the step count or the outcome.
- Gaming and vlogs — Keep the face and the scene readable together, with the expression carrying the hook.
- Podcasts and series — Hold one layout across episodes so the series is recognizable in a subscription feed.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill youtube-thumbnail-maker`
- Installer for any agent: https://beatra.ai/skills/youtube-thumbnail-maker/install.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/beatra-ai/beatra-skills/tree/main/skills/youtube-thumbnail-maker

MCP tools: `beatra.images.generate`, `beatra.images.transform`, `beatra.images.edit`

FAQ:

### Can I start from just a title?

Yes. A title and the promise behind it are enough to shape directions; a key frame or portrait gives the hero subject something real to build on.

### Can you use a frame from my video?

Export the frame or take a screenshot and share it, and it becomes the hero subject the thumbnail is built around.

### Can I put text in the image?

Yes. Give the exact wording and where it should sit, and it is set before rendering so the layout is built around it. Image models do not always draw letters exactly, and changing a word means rendering the thumbnail again, so you can also keep the text out of the image: leave a clear headline area and set the title yourself afterwards.

### Can I keep one look across a series?

Yes. An accepted direction becomes a channel rule covering subject placement, contrast, and text area, so later episodes match.

- What-is-X explainers — One concept per short, from the common confusion to the one takeaway.
- Mechanism and contrast teardowns — Processes, comparisons, and boundaries drawn while they are explained.
- Benchmark-driven remakes — Learn a reference video's structure, then film your own version in whiteboard style.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill whiteboard-animation-maker`
- Installer for any agent: https://beatra.ai/skills/whiteboard-animation-maker/install.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/beatra-ai/beatra-skills/tree/main/skills/whiteboard-animation-maker

MCP tools: `beatra.voices.list`, `beatra.speech.synthesize`, `beatra.voices.clone`, `beatra.social.tools.search`, `beatra.social.tools.get`, `beatra.social.execute`

FAQ:

### What do I need to start?

Any one of three: a concept to explain, a finished script, or a benchmark video link. Audience, length, and voice choices can follow in the conversation.

### Can it write English as well as Chinese?

Yes — short English words are drawn stroke by stroke like Chinese characters; longer English sentences stay as readable text while the drawing carries the scene.

### Where does the film come from?

On your computer: one 1080×1920 vertical whiteboard film, with words landing as they are spoken.

## GPT Image 2.5 Studio (`gpt-image-2-5-studio`)

Create one GPT Image 2.5 still from a brief or reference images with Flare or Sunburst.

Create one GPT Image 2.5 still from a written brief or from one to four reference images. GPT Image 2.5 Studio uses GPT-Image-2.5 Flare (gpt-image-2.5-flare) or GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst (gpt-image-2.5-sunburst) for ChatGPT Images 2.5 text to image and reference-guided pictures. Make posters, product stills, infographics, social crops, and campaign frames with readable on-image type.

Use cases:
- Posters and campaign frames — Set the headline, layout, and crop, then generate one launch or event still.
- Product stills — Guide a new product frame from a written brief or ordered product references.
- Infographics and social crops — Lay out readable type on square, story, or ultra-wide canvases.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill gpt-image-2-5-studio`

FAQ:

### What do I need to start?

A visual direction. Add one to four reference images when they should guide the new still.

### What is Flare versus Sunburst?

Flare is the everyday GPT Image 2.5 still. Sunburst is the finer GPT-Image-2.5 option when identity and type need extra care.

### What can I make?

Posters, product stills, infographics, social crops, and campaign frames with readable on-image type.

## Micro-Lesson Maker (`micro-lesson-maker`)

One lesson's slides or a single topic into a narrated micro-lesson video with subtitles and an optional digital-human opening.

Make a micro-lesson video from one lesson's slides or a single topic. When there are no slides it drafts them first, then writes the script page by page and adds narration, subtitles, and the teacher's photo or a digital-human opening, delivering a 5-to-10-minute lesson video. For micro-lesson contests, demo lesson recordings, flipped classroom video, review lessons, and short explainer video for students.

Use cases:
- Micro-lesson contests — Turn a contest topic into a 5-to-10-minute micro-lesson video with slides, narration, and subtitles.
- Open and demo lessons — Record an open lesson or a demo lesson as a video to rehearse with and to share with colleagues.
- Preview and review lessons — Give students one short video per topic to watch before class or to review after it.

- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill micro-lesson-maker`

FAQ:

### Can I start without slides?

Yes. Give the topic and the grade, and a deck is drafted for you to edit before the video is made.

### Can it use my own voice?

Yes. Your voice is cloned once and then explains every slide.

### What will I receive?

A 5-to-10-minute micro-lesson video with its subtitle file and the script for every slide; when you started from a topic, the editable deck too.

## AI Courseware Maker (`ai-courseware-maker`)

Turn a topic, grade, and lesson length into an editable PowerPoint lesson deck with matching illustrations and the script in the notes.

AI courseware from a topic, grade, and lesson length: an editable PowerPoint lesson deck structured into warm-up, new content, practice, and summary. Key lesson slides get illustrations in one consistent style over a matching background, the teacher's script sits in the speaker notes, and the teaching slides open in PowerPoint or WPS ready to edit, with slide illustrations and the whole lesson deck in one style.

Use cases:
- New lessons — Prepare a new lesson from a textbook chapter: a 40-minute lesson deck with illustrations and the script.
- Demo and open lessons — Present a lesson design to a panel, from textbook analysis to the board plan, or teach an open lesson with one polished, consistent deck.
- Class and parent meetings — A class meeting or parent meeting deck laid out as a theme, talking points, and an action list, with fitting illustrations.

Install:
- `npx skills add beatra-ai/beatra-skills --skill ai-courseware-maker`

MCP tools: `beatra.images.generate`

FAQ:

### Can I edit the deck afterwards?

Yes. It is a normal PowerPoint file: change the text, pictures, and notes in PowerPoint or WPS.

### Can it follow my textbook or lesson plan?

Yes. Send the textbook pages or your lesson plan and the slides follow them.

### What will I receive?

An editable 16:9 PowerPoint lesson deck, usually 10 to 20 slides, with illustrations and a background in one style and the script in every slide's notes.
